solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Old vehicle cut into flier

indicators.note: the cut is put into the flier, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a jay is a bird, a flier
to lop is to cut off

explanation.surface: An old car is chopped up and crashes into a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A jalopy is a battered, worn-out old motor car.

clue.text: Lift shirt up to reveal the best prize!

parts.note: a jack is a device that lifts a car

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word shirt's synonym is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a top is a shirt or other upper garment

explanation.surface: Someone raises their shirt to show off a winning prize.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns TOP into POT after JACK.
explanation.definitionFit: A jackpot is the largest prize available in a lottery or game.

clue.text: Criminal dressed in scarlet

indicators.note: dressed means arranged or prepared, so these letters are set out anew

explanation.surface: A villain wearing red clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A larcenist commits larceny, theft, so is a kind of criminal.

clue.text: Clergyman's quiet crime

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
arson, setting fires deliberately, is a crime

explanation.surface: A clergyman's silent wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: A parson is a parish priest, a member of the clergy.

clue.text: 11, where perfect girl starts to run backwards, backwards

indicators.note: the second backwards turns the whole assembled string end to end

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written AI here
Lisa is a girl's name

indicators.note: the starts of the words run and backwards are taken

explanation.surface: A city where a flawless girl begins running in reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: '11' points to 11-down, CAPITAL. AI + LISA + RB gives AILISARB, which the second 'backwards' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: Brasilia is the capital city of Brazil, which is what the cross-reference to the other entry means.

clue.text: Horse extracting the pith from tree

indicators.note: the pith is the central core, so the middle letter of the tree's name is taken out

parts.note: the rowan is the mountain ash tree

explanation.surface: A horse pulling the soft core out of a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: ROWAN has five letters; its centre, W, is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A roan is a horse whose coat has white hairs mixed into a base colour.

clue.text: Bird kept in drain

indicators.note: kept is placed in drain, one piece inside the other

parts.note: to suck is to drain liquid out
held means kept

explanation.surface: A bird trapped in a drain.
explanation.definitionFit: The shelduck is a large, boldly coloured duck of coasts and estuaries.

clue.text: Let loose initially, then relax

indicators.note: initially means the opening letter of loose is taken

parts.note: to ease is to relax or slacken

explanation.surface: Set something free first, then unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: To let a property is to rent it out under a lease agreement.

clue.text: Deal with personal details

definitions.meaning: to tackle or handle a problem
where someone lives, given on a form along with name and so on

explanation.definitionFit: One verb sense is to tackle an issue; the noun is the place someone lives, part of their particulars.

clue.text: Poison that's copper red

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
rare meat is red in the middle

explanation.surface: A toxin with a reddish-copper colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Curare is a plant-derived paralysing poison used on South American arrows.

clue.text: Queen, perhaps, has to confront joker

parts.note: to face someone is to confront them
a card is a joker, a comic person

explanation.surface: A queen must stand up to a jester.
explanation.definitionFit: A queen is one example of a court or picture card in a pack.

clue.text: Hamilton, perhaps, excellent

definitions.meaning: Hamilton is the chief city of Bermuda, an example of a seat of government
an old-fashioned British exclamation meaning first-rate

explanation.definitionFit: A capital is a chief city such as Hamilton in Bermuda, and as an adjective it means splendid.

clue.text: Grinder ending in flour east of Palermo, perhaps

indicators.note: in an across answer east is to the right, so the letter goes after
perhaps suggests a possible version of the city's name, so its letters are rearranged
the final letter of flour is taken

explanation.surface: A mill, the last stage in flour making, out east of a Sicilian city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges PALERMO into PREMOLA, and the R from 'ending in flour' sits after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A premolar is a tooth that grinds food, between the canines and molars.

clue.text: Bill has arrived, secure

parts.note: an ad is a bill or poster advertisement
someone who has arrived is here

explanation.surface: The invoice has come in, safe and sound.
explanation.definitionFit: To adhere is to stick fast, to be secured or attached.

clue.text: Egyptian ruler dismissing staff from employment before going insane

indicators.note: going insane signals the remaining letters become disordered
dismissing means the staff are sent out of the word employment

parts.note: men are the staff or workers

explanation.surface: A pharaoh sacks his workers and then loses his mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissing' removes MEN from EMPLOYMENT, leaving EMPLOYT; 'going insane' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ptolemy was the name of the Macedonian dynasty of kings who ruled Egypt after Alexander.

clue.text: Double double-u preserved?

annotationWithheld.why: Double double-u preserved? (4): W in TIN; 'preserved' is both TIN and the container indicator, one word doing two jobs

clue.text: Sci-fi stuff, weird hand-to-hand combat

indicators.note: weird means strange or out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Odd science-fiction material featuring brawling.
explanation.definitionFit: Fisticuffs is fighting with the fists, a bare-knuckle brawl.

clue.text: Number over fifty? Wrong!

indicators.note: wrong means not in the right order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone guesses an age above fifty and is told they are mistaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' looks like a figure to compare, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Forty-five is a whole number, the sum of forty and five.

clue.text: What's in a vacuum? It's not important

definitions.meaning: a vacuum is empty space containing no substance at all
an idiom brushing something aside as irrelevant

explanation.definitionFit: A true vacuum contains no physical substance, and the idiom dismisses something as of no consequence.

clue.text: Story to squeeze in, not entirely clear

indicators.note: the story is to squeeze the other piece into its middle

parts.note: a fable is a moral story

indicators.note: not entirely means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: someone in is at home

explanation.surface: A story is crammed in, and it is not completely understandable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' means AT HOME; 'not entirely' cuts it to ATHOM, which goes inside FABLE between FA and BLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fathomable can be understood, so its meaning is clear.

clue.text: Dandy carrying sophisticated type of light

indicators.note: carrying means the dandy holds the other piece inside

parts.note: a fop is a dandy, a vain man fussy about dress
glam, short for glamorous, means stylish and sophisticated

explanation.surface: A dandy holding a stylish kind of lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A fog lamp is a bright car light used in poor visibility.

clue.text: Pull tie

explanation.definitionFit: To draw is to pull along, and a draw is a match ending with equal scores.

clue.text: Some horse fades

definitions.meaning: part of a horse: the ridge between its shoulder blades

explanation.definitionFit: The ridge between a horse's shoulders bears this name, and to shrivel or wilt is the verb sense.

clue.text: A pastry's rising layers

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the pieces are read from the bottom up

parts.note: tarts are pastries, with the possessive giving the plural sense

explanation.surface: A pastry puffing up into layers as it bakes.
explanation.walkthrough: A TARTS read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Strata are layers, especially of rock or of society.

clue.text: Garrulous type while bragging initially, breaking silence

indicators.note: breaking means the pieces burst into the middle of silence

parts.note: a gag silences someone
as means while, at the time that

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of bragging

explanation.surface: A chatterbox boasting at first and then breaking the quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasbag is someone who talks too much, a windbag.

clue.text: Hindu leader floated over Iranian leader

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: swam means floated or moved through water

indicators.note: the leader of Iranian is its first letter

explanation.surface: A religious leader drifting over to an Iranian chief.
explanation.definitionFit: A swami is a Hindu religious teacher or holy man.

clue.text: February stone replacing the May stone

indicators.note: replacing means placing again in a new order, so those letters are rearranged

parts.note: st is the abbreviation for stone, the British unit of weight

explanation.surface: One birthstone taking the place of another month's gem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'replacing' rearranges THE MAY into AMETHY; ST (stone) follows. 'the May stone' looks like the emerald.
explanation.definitionFit: The amethyst, a purple quartz, is the traditional birthstone for those born in February.

clue.text: Sculpture reduced to rubble?

explanation.definitionFit: A head-and-shoulders statue carries this name, and informally it also means broken.

clue.text: Plant a vessel in that manner

parts.note: a can is a container, a vessel
thus means in this or that way

explanation.surface: Instructions for putting a plant in a pot just so.
explanation.definitionFit: Acanthus is a spiny Mediterranean plant whose leaves inspired classical column decoration.

clue.text: Mother of Argentina, name recollected for mother

indicators.note: recollected read as re-collected, gathered up again in a new order

parts.note: Eva Peron, known as Evita, was revered as a mother figure of Argentina

explanation.surface: Argentina's adored first lady's name is remembered as maternal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' rearranges EVITA + N; read straight backwards they give the answer too. 'mother' is the adjective, as in mother tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Native and mother both describe one's own land or language from birth, as in mother tongue.

clue.text: Shame about port, right? It's one's first concern

indicators.note: about means the shame word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a pity is a shame, as in what a pity
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A rhetorical question about the disgrace of a harbour being one's main worry.
explanation.definitionFit: A priority is the thing given most importance, dealt with before all else.

clue.text: Stroke nurses before introduction of sister

indicators.note: before means the first piece comes ahead of the next

parts.note: cares for means nurses; cares is used as a verb here

indicators.note: the introduction of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Nurses tend patients before a ward sister arrives.
explanation.definitionFit: To caress is to stroke someone gently and affectionately.
